title: Migrate microphone reverb to the processor config-class API
problem: The microphone reverb processor still exposes four constructor keywords, so the current processor decorator rejects the module during import.
reproduce: Import ReverbEffect against published StreamLib 0.22.6; the baseline decorator raises that a processor config must be one class.
acceptance: ReverbEffect takes one annotated dataclass config, preserves all four defaults and range checks, and imports against the current published wheel.
repair: Add ReverbEffectConfig, consume its fields in the constructor, and add focused default and validation tests.

selection.reason: A same-day owner-filed audio regression has an exact decorator error, published-wheel reproduction, no competing PR, and a small specified migration.

verification.limitations: BCL's portable regression enforces the config-class decorator contract and construction tests. Separately, the candidate imported and constructed with StreamLib 0.22.6 on amd64. The complete microphone-to-speaker graph was not run because it requires audio hardware.
verification.ownerCheck: Run the example with a microphone and speaker after uv sync, confirm the graph reaches Running, and verify the default wet/dry mix sounds unchanged.
